figures.caption: Chemical structures of clovibactin and d-Thr5-clovibactin. The rare, noncanonical amino acid d-hydroxyasparagine (d-Hyn) is highlighted in red. d-Thr5-clovibactin is a synthetic analogue of clovibactin in which d-Hyn is replaced with d-threonine (highlighted in blue).
